name: ASLN 3292
title: Experiential Learning
description: This course is for students who wish to extend their knowledge and experience in American Sign Language and Deaf studies as tutors and as Instructional Assistants in related courses. May be repeated for a total of 12 credits.
requirement_description: Approval of Experiential Learning Supervisor, instructor consent required. Recommended preparation: Completion of the course for which the student will provide tutoring services.
